backlog.name: Quote builder
backlog.does: Line items, optional GST, logo, PDF
backlog.notes: Hand-written by Ting Yu. Its calc module is meant to be reused by the invoice builder.

backlog.name: Invoice builder
backlog.does: Same engine, invoice numbering, PayNow QR on the PDF
backlog.notes: Reuses the quote builder's calc. Needs the IRAS GST rate and tax invoice requirements, and the PayNow QR format (SGQR, checked against the official spec) for the QR.

backlog.name: PayNow QR maker
backlog.does: PayNow QR for a UEN or mobile, with amount and reference
backlog.notes: Depends on the PayNow and SGQR format. Confirm against an official source (MAS or the scheme operator) before writing; pick another idea if it can't be confirmed.

backlog.name: Receipt reader
backlog.does: Receipt photos to a table, CSV and Excel
backlog.notes: Hand-written by Ting Yu. Built after the rate limiter (app factory PRD block 3).

backlog.name: Payslip maker
backlog.does: Itemised payslip covering the items MOM lists, PDF
backlog.notes: Needs MOM's list of itemised payslip items (mom.gov.sg). If it works out CPF, it is a statutory calculator, so it needs the CPF Board source and an estimate label.

backlog.name: Delivery order maker
backlog.does: DO with signature box, PDF
backlog.notes: No statutory rule. Shares the document layout with the quote builder.

backlog.name: GST checker
backlog.does: Add or remove GST from a price, cites the IRAS rate
backlog.notes: Statutory calculator. Needs the IRAS GST rate page with the date checked, and an estimate label.

backlog.name: Document text grabber
backlog.does: Client-side OCR of an image to editable text
backlog.notes: Tesseract.js in the browser. No statutory rule.

backlog.name: PDF merge and split
backlog.does: In the browser
backlog.notes: pdf-lib in the browser. Very generic, suits every industry. No statutory rule. Skipped by Ting Yu on 2026-10-31 (approval A-0001).

backlog.name: Leave planner
backlog.does: Team leave calendar from a CSV, SG public holidays marked
backlog.notes: Needs the MOM public holidays page for the dates. Must not give leave entitlement advice.

backlog.name: Timesheet to invoice
backlog.does: Hours CSV to an invoice draft
backlog.notes: Best after the invoice builder, so it can share the engine.

backlog.name: Bank statement sorter
backlog.does: Categorise a bank CSV export with the visitor's own rules
backlog.notes: The visitor's own categories only. No financial advice and no bank logins.

backlog.name: Price list maker
backlog.does: Product list to a printable catalogue PDF
backlog.notes: No statutory rule.

backlog.name: QR code maker
backlog.does: URL, Wi-Fi, vCard; PNG and SVG
backlog.notes: Generic. No statutory rule.

backlog.name: Email reply helper
backlog.does: Customer email to a polite reply draft
backlog.notes: AI tier, so it uses the shared limiter. The visitor's email is data, never instructions.

backlog.name: Job ad writer
backlog.does: Role details to a clear job ad
backlog.notes: AI tier. Should follow the Tripartite Guidelines on Fair Employment Practices on discriminatory wording; cite the official page if the PRD relies on it.

backlog.name: Meeting notes tidier
backlog.does: Rough notes to actions, owners, dates
backlog.notes: AI tier. No statutory rule.

backlog.name: Social caption kit
backlog.does: Product description to captions per platform
backlog.notes: AI tier. Must not post to any platform on the visitor's behalf.

backlog.name: Time-saved calculator
backlog.does: Visitor's own task times and frequency to their own totals
backlog.notes: The visitor's own figures only. The page must never show a Jura figure or claim time saved; the numbers rule applies to every word of the copy.

backlog.name: Business card reader
backlog.does: Card photo to vCard or CSV
backlog.notes: AI tier. The card holds someone else's personal data, so nothing is stored or logged.

backlog.name: Site visit report
backlog.does: Site visit report: write up a site visit with photos and a signature, and save it as a PDF
backlog.notes: Sent by Ting Yu with `apps idea` on 2026-10-30.

backlog.name: Van check sheet
backlog.does: Van check sheet: a daily van inspection checklist for drivers
backlog.notes: Sent by Ting Yu with `apps idea` on 2026-10-31.
